name: Noko
source:
A huge otaku who is actually a bit of an internet celebrity. If she can help it, she leaves the house as little as possible, usually leaving only for working at the Dream Club; which is her first and only place of employment, on days where she doesn't have work she follows her usual routine of staying locked up at home, watching anime or playing games. Noko does however have a pretty good fashion sense, being relatively well known online for her fashion blog.

[spoiler]Her real name is Utashiro Noriko (歌代 紀子).[/spoiler]
